title: tc-provenance-summary
description:
What a document is made of: the share from sources, AI synthesis and original writing, per section and in total,
with each segment opening its lineage.

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

scope.description: What the summary covers, a quiet line under the heading – e.g. the document's name

sections.description: The document's sections, in order, with how much of each came from where

unit.description: The unit of the amounts, plural – "words", "characters", "sentences"

totalLabel.description: The name of the whole-document row

totalOnly.description: Hide the per-section rows and show the total only

sourced.description: How much came from sources – quoted, paraphrased or cited

synthesis.description: How much the AI wrote from what it was given

original.description: How much the authors wrote themselves
